compatibilityShims.name: socketioxide-parser-common
compatibilityShims.reason: Pinned compatibility adapter for socketioxide 0.18.2; no packet framing or browser-client patch.

compatibilityShims.name: rust_socketio acknowledgement-array normalization
compatibilityShims.reason: rust_socketio 0.6.0 exposes acknowledgement arguments as one JSON array; the fixture unwraps exactly one argument before contract validation.

compatibilityShims.name: rust_socketio logical-auth probe settling
compatibilityShims.reason: Engine.IO may report transport success before namespace middleware rejection is observable, so the fixture waits 50ms and requires an allowed acknowledgement.

compatibilityShims.name: Socketioxide polling-upgrade guard
compatibilityShims.reason: Socketioxide advertises upgrades before the authenticated role is known; fixture middleware rejects websocket upgrades carrying a polling sid.

compatibilityShims.name: fixture-only capability handoff
compatibilityShims.reason: The random internal capability crosses processes without entering argv, environment variables, structured output, or the disposable journal.

compatibilityShims.name: fixture-only stopping transition control
compatibilityShims.reason: The compatibility fixture exposes a deterministic stopping boundary so Chromium can assert the exact server_stopping RPC wrapper without adding a production protocol event.

compatibilityShims.name: packages/happy-app/sources/polyfills/screenOrientation.ts
compatibilityShims.reason: The entry-first web polyfill preserves native screen.orientation and supplies the historical WebKit fallback; Chromium used its native implementation.
